{{pkmn|Masters EX}} |trainer=[[Pokémon Trainer]], [[player character]] |counterpart=[[Hilda (Masters)]] |enva=[[Erica Mendez]][https://twitter.com/tsunderica/status/1178749361343234048 Erica Mendez on Twitter] ({{pkmn|Masters EX}}) |jpva=Mariko Nagai[https://twitter.com/nagadon0103/status/1178891551851679745 Mariko Nagai on Twitter] ({{pkmn|Masters EX}}) }} {{Character Infobox/Anime |color={{white color light}} |series=''[[Pokémon Evolutions]]'' |debut=''[[PE04|The Plan]]'' |enva=Unknown |jpva=Hina Natsume }} {{Character Infobox/Manga |color={{white color light}} |series=''[[Pokémon Adventures]]'' |counterpart=[[White (Adventures)]] |debut=''[[PS465|Lights, Camera...Action!]]'' }} |} '''Hilda''' (Japanese: '''トウコ''' ''Touko'') is the female [[player character]] in {{game|Black and White|s}}. Her male counterpart is {{ga|Hilbert}}. ==In the core series games== ==={{game|Black and White|s}}=== ====As the protagonist==== Hilda is a 14-year-old girl who lives in [[Nuvema Town]], along with her childhood friends [[Cheren]] and [[Bianca]]. If chosen as the player, she will receive a [[first partner Pokémon]] and a [[Pokédex]] from [[Professor Juniper]]. After setting off on her [[Pokémon journey]] at the same time as Cheren and Bianca, Hilda will at some point be asked by [[Fennel]] to do some sort of quest; in return for its completion, Hilda will receive a [[C-Gear]]. As well as encountering and battling her childhood friends at various points during her journey, Hilda will also meet a young man known as [[N]], who wishes to create separate worlds for humans and Pokémon. In order to achieve his goals, he and Hilda will battle several times during the course of the game. Hilda will also battle [[Team Plasma]] at various stages of her journey. At the game's climax, Hilda is recognized as a hero by {{p|Reshiram}}{{Sup/5|B}}/{{p|Zekrom}}{{Sup/5|W}}. ====As a non-playable character==== If not chosen as the player, Hilda appears as the player's partner in the [[Battle Subway]] when choosing to ride the Multi-Train. Two of the following Pokémon are picked from the corresponding list, depending on what the player wants her to base her team on. If the player chooses "A balance between the two," Hilda's Pokémon are chosen from either list. ==={{B2W2}}=== In Black 2 and White 2, the protagonist of Black and White was said to be searching for N in a faraway region and has not yet returned home. Her mom mistakes the player for her. ===Pokémon=== {{SubwayPartner |color={{white color}} |headcolor={{white color light}} |bordercolor={{white color dark}} |sprite=BW Hilda Back |name=Hilda |game=BW}} ==In the spin-off games== [[File:SSBU Pokemon Trainer palette Hilda.png|200px|thumb|The female Pokémon Trainer's Hilda-based alternate palette in [[Super Smash Bros. Ultimate]]]] ===[[Super Smash Bros. Ultimate]]=== While Hilda herself does not appear directly, a palette swap color scheme based on Hilda's design appears for the female {{OBP|Pokémon Trainer|Super Smash Bros.}}, who is an incarnation of {{ga|Leaf}}. ===[[Pokémon Masters EX]]=== {{main|Hilda (Masters)}} Hilda, who is based on the [[Battle Subway]] partner, forms a [[sync pair]] with {{p|Tepig}} and its evolved forms {{p|Pignite}} and {{p|Emboar}}, along with {{p|Diancie}}, {{Shiny}} {{p|Grapploct}}, {{p|Victini}}, {{p|Leafeon}}, {{form|Tornadus|Incarnate Forme}} {{p|Tornadus}}, {{p|Iron Leaves}}, and {{p|Mienfoo}} in [[Pokémon Masters EX]]. Her Diancie is capable of [[Mega Evolution|Mega Evolving]]. Hilda became a playable sync pair on September 30, 2019. Hilda first appeared as an NPC during the eighteenth chapter of the [[PML arc]]. She was first seen in a flashback, playing with her {{p|Tepig}} and being attracted to watch [[Ghetsis]]'s speech in [[Accumula Town]]. In the present day, she appeared at [[N's Castle]], showing Ghetsis that she had obtained the [[Light Stone]], before stepping into the castle's throne room to battle [[N]]. =====Pokémon===== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Hilda |pkmn=Tepig |type1=Fire |img=Hilda Tepig Evolutions.png |epnum=PE04 |epname=The Plan |vajp= |vaen= |desc={{p|Tepig}} appeared in a flashback, where Hilda was seen playing with and taking care of it in [[Accumula Town]]. None of Tepig's moves are known.}} =====Voice actors===== {{vatable|color={{white color}}|bordercolor={{white color light}} |ja=夏目妃菜 ''Hina Natsume'' |en=}} ====GOTCHA!==== Hilda briefly appeared in [[GOTCHA!]]. ===In the manga=== [[File:White Adventures.png|thumb|130px|White, Hilda's Pokémon Adventures counterpart]] ====Pokémon Adventures==== {{main|White (Adventures)}} Hilda has a counterpart in [[Pokémon Adventures]] named White, who debuted in the {{MangaArc|Black & White}}. She works for an advertisement company called the [[BW Agency]], and she gets the idea to hire {{adv|Black}} upon seeing the bond the latter's {{p|Tepig}} had with a female of its species. In this [[canon]], she is the founder of the [[Pokémon Musical]] and [[Pokéstar Studios]]. {{-}} ==Merchandise== ===Kotobukiya ArtFX J Figure=== Hilda and her partner Pokémon, Tepig, were released as a [[Kotobukiya figurines|Kotobukiya figurine]] on March 2018 and November 2019. {{color2|000|HM}}s |} == In the TCG == [[File:HildaWhiteFlare164.jpg|200px|thumb|Full Art print of Hilda in the TCG]] {{main|Hilda (White Flare 84)}} '''Hilda''' was introduced as a {{TCG|Supporter card}} in the [[Pokémon Trading Card Game]] during the English Scarlet & Violet Series (the Japanese Scarlet & Violet Era). It was first released in the Japanese {{TCG|Black Bolt/White Flare|White Flare}} expansion before debuting in {{TCG|White Flare|the English expansion of the same name}}, with artwork by [[yuu]]. An {{TCG|ultra rare}} version with artwork by the same illustrator and a {{TCG|special illustration rare}} version with artwork by [[Naoki Saito]] were released in the same sets. This card lets the player search their deck for an [[:Category:Evolution cards|Evolution Pokémon]] and an {{TCG|Energy card}}, and put them into their hand. {{-}} ==Trivia== * [[Pokémon Black 2 and White 2 beta#Pokémon World Tournament|Unused text]] in {{B2W2}} indicates that Hilda and {{ga|Hilbert}} were originally planned to be battled at the [[Pokémon World Tournament]]. * Hilda and Hilbert are the first [[player character]]s in the [[core series]] {{pkmn|games}} not to have pre-programmed names either by choice or in case one isn't specified. * In the May 2010 volume of [[CoroCoro]] Comics and the January 2011 volume of Nintendo Dream, it was stated that Hilda and Hilbert are older than previous player characters, but it is not said how much older they actually are. ** According to game scenario author [[Toshinobu Matsumiya]], Hilda and Hilbert were initially visualized to be at the age of 16.[http://archive.is/THahx Twitter | マツミや @matsumiyan] ==Names== This character is named '''Hilda''' (Japanese: '''トウコ''' ''Touko'') in her NPC appearance in the Battle Subway. It is also her most commonly used name, being used in merchandising and the {{g|Masters EX}} [[Spin-off Pokémon games|spin-off game]]. Her Japanese name was spelled as '''Touko''' on the packaging of [[Kotobukiya figurines|Kotobukiya ArtFX J Figure]]. She was named '''White''' (Japanese: '''ホワイト''' ''White'') in certain pre-release material. English demos for Black and White refer to the character as '''Whitlea''', while English screenshots refer to her as '''Shiro'''. If a transferred Pokémon that has a trainer with a [[Poké Transporter#Censored words|prohibited name]] comes from Black or Black 2, the Pokémon's OT will be set to '''Kuro*''' (Japanese: '''ブラック．''' ''Black.''), while Pokémon from White or White 2 will have their OT set to '''Shiro*''' (Japanese: '''ホワイト．''' ''White.'') {| class="roundtable" style="background:#{{white color}}; border:3px solid #{{white color dark}}" |- ! style="background:#{{white color light}}" | Language ! style="background:#{{white color light}}" | Name ! style="background:#{{white color light}}" | Origin |- | Japanese | トウコ ''Touko'' | From 闘 ''tō'' (fight) and ～子 ''-ko'' (common suffix in Japanese feminine names) |- | English, Indonesian,
